key_insight: A margin-based analysis links LoRA’s resistance to catastrophic forgetting and mergeability, motivating MaLoRA’s training-free adapter-merging rule.
engineering_relevance: MaLoRA offers a principled way to combine task-specific LoRA adapters using mixing coefficients designed to balance task margins.
method: Analyze multiclass linear LoRA under near-orthogonal tasks and ℓ₂ regularization.
Show max-margin alignment at intermediate regularization and quantify the retention–adaptation trade-off.
Derive merge coefficients that maximize the minimum margin across tasks.
evidence_signal: Experiments on modern architectures and real vision and language classification datasets report MaLoRA matching or outperforming several adapter-merging baselines.
watch_item: Theoretical guarantees rely on a linear, near-orthogonal task setting; applicability to nonlinear models with strongly overlapping tasks needs validation.
paper_title: A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging (MaLoRA)
